items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: And then I even took a license with Albert Snyder.

ctx.x: He and the King Brothers I think, I met him at the same time. They had two brothers, King Brothers, both of them played trumpet and I think Nat was playing trombone with him, playing with Faith's all the time.

And then he was playing trombone with him. And then he was playing with Faith's all the time. And then I even took a license with Albert Snyder. He used to work on the Capitol with Faith too for a long time. And the band with Robichaud, you remember?
I don't know if you remember. Joe Robichaud? Joe Robichaud? And they had Baby Briscoe. Oh yeah, and that bunch there, and all that bunch there.
